name: UI Review
author: Brett
description: Every UI a build makes comes here for Brett's approval, one section per kind (open registry: Design packs, Whole apps / programs, Screens & pages, Settings interfaces, Dialogs & popups, Menus & toolbars, Banners & cards, Other). Each item carries its app, build, branch and PR, desktop + phone screenshots, notes, a status (waiting, approved, changes asked, rejected), his comment and its history. Views: tree, collapsible grid, grid with sub-grids, gallery and side-by-side compare, all with multi-select and bulk Approve / Ask changes / Reject. Builds submit through review.mjs, POST /api/plugins/ui-review/submit or rebuild-shots --submit; other plugins read the per-branch / per-PR state through the ui-review@1 capability. Design packs (formerly their own plugin) are one section: pick up to 3. Screenshots tab (ui-screenshot@1): ad-hoc pictures (check sessions, live captures, PR before/after, uploads) that never enter the approve / reject queue, saved with axf shot / POST shots / Upload; grid grouped by app, screen, source or day, thumbnails, full-screen viewer with before/after slider, copy link, delete, Send to review. Predicted looks (ui-prediction@1): when a build that changes UI is launched, framework/cli/ui-predict.mjs makes a mockup of each screen it will touch (framework controls, current theme, demo data) and files it here as 'Predicted - approve the look' next to the screen as it is now; Approve look / Ask changes (the comment goes to the build) / Reject (the build is held). Setting: wait for the look approval before UI builds start. The predicted pictures refresh while the build runs and the real after-shots replace them at the end (badge Real, predicted vs real compare). Review alarm (ui-review-alarm@1): a new item opens UI Review and notifies the phone; unreviewed for 30 min it rings a loud alarm on the phone (and the banner), and 5 min later it follows Brett's switch 'When the alarm isn't answered': auto-approve (default, logged, undoable) or leave it waiting; tapping the alarm pauses it. Settings: window, grace, sound, quiet hours, scope. List: sort by time added (newest first), group by PR / date / build / type, PR + item id on every row, deep links ?item= / ?pr=.

items.title: List predicted looks
items.description: Every predicted look (ui-prediction@1) in UI Review, or one build's, with its look gate verdict (go / wait / held) and the 'wait for my look approval' setting.
items.output: { settings, items: ui-review-item@1[] with verdict, verdict? }

items.title: Predict a build's look
items.description: Make (or refresh) a build's predicted item: the mockup pictures (predicted-*.png) and the screen as it is now (before-*.png). framework/cli/ui-predict.mjs predict <build> makes the pictures and calls this.

items.title: Real shots replace the predicted look
items.description: The build finished: its real after-shots replace the mockup (badge Real); the item waits for the real approval, the look decision and the predicted pictures stay for the compare.

items.title: Decide a predicted look
items.description: Brett's decision on a build's predicted look: approve, changes (the comment goes to the build as an addendum) or reject (the build is held).

items.title: Look approval setting
items.description: 'Wait for my look approval before UI builds start' (waitForLook, default off).

items.title: Set the look approval setting
items.description: Turn 'Wait for my look approval before UI builds start' on or off.

items.title: UI Review alarm status
items.description: The review alarm (ui-review-alarm@1): its settings, and per waiting item when the alarm rings, when the switch acts, and its phase (none, alarm, answered, approved, held, done), plus the recent log.
items.output: { settings, since, now, items: {id: {phase, alarmAt, actAt}}, log }

items.title: UI Review alarm settings
items.description: The alarm settings: window (30 min), grace (5 min), the switch 'When the alarm isn't answered' (approve | hold), sound, volume, vibrate, quiet hours, scope.

items.title: Change the UI Review alarm
items.description: Change the review alarm. Voice: "don't auto-approve UI reviews" = {unanswered: hold}; "auto-approve UI reviews again" = {unanswered: approve}; "turn off the UI Review alarm" = {enabled: false}; "give me 45 minutes" = {windowMin: 45}.

unanswered.description: When the alarm isn't answered: approve = auto-approve (run it), hold = don't run it (leave it waiting)

graceMin.description: minutes after the alarm before the switch acts (default 5)

openOnNew.description: open UI Review on each new item and notify the phone

quietMode.description: during quiet hours: silent = follow the switch without ringing, hold = wait for quiet hours to end

scope.description: every item, or only items blocking a merge (PR / branch)

items.title: Answer the UI Review alarm
items.description: The alarm was tapped: that item's countdown stops until Brett approves or rejects it himself.

items.title: Undo an auto-approval
items.description: Re-open an item the alarm auto-approved (back to waiting) and restart its clock.

items.title: Run the UI Review alarm timer now
items.description: Check every waiting item now (the ticker does this every 30 seconds).
